verdict.rationale: Mixpanel ships a dedicated Funnels report to "measure conversions through a series of events" and markets finding "critical drop-off points," in interactive reports built "with just a few clicks." Session Replay lets users explore why customers drop off, and natural-language funnel queries via MCP further reduce the need for an analyst. A community user notes PMs "quickly generating custom report after custom report," which supports non-analyst self-serve use. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of per-step drop-off breakdowns (the funnel docs evidence is a single line), and independent hands-on corroboration that founders specifically use funnel drop-off analysis without help.
